title: Ammu ne akela
body:
har dam tha sakina ka nauha
ammu ne akela chod diya
chut'te hi madina zulm hua
ammu ne akela chod diya
<<DIVIDER>>
bachpan se abhi tak saath rahe
darya se nahi lekin palte
jeene ka nahi ab koi maza
ammu ne akela chod diya
har dam tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kaun pilayega pani
hai kaun jo layega pani
zainab se musalsal tha shikwa
ammu ne akela chod diya
har dam tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum pyaas jo apni seh jaate
kuch aur wo zinda reh jaate
pani ka taqaaza aisa kiya
ammu ne akela chod diya
har dam tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab godh may zainab ki baithi
sajjad ke jab seene se lagi
ek saans may sau sau baar kaha
ammu ne akela chod diya
har dam tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon ki lakeerein mitni lagi
ab acche mere haalaat nahi
kismat ne diya aisa tohfa
ammu ne akela chod diya
har dam tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke ghar bhar ki pyari
zindan e sitam may jab pahunchi
jab dard utha moo se nikla
ammu ne akela chod diya
har dam tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan e musibat may ishrat
bigdi jo sakina ki haalat
ye kehte huwe dam tod diya
ammu ne akela chod diya
har dam tha...
author: Ishrat Lakhnavi
